newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Mosenergo to pay 1996 dividends.
newsitem.headline: Russia Mosenergo to pay 1996 dividends.

text.p: Russian regional power utility AO Mosenergo is considering paying dividends for 1996 and their amount will be set at the shareholders' meeting in April, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
"We paid 128 billion roubles in dividends on 1995 results and this year's sum should not be smaller," he told Reuters.
In 1995 Mosenergo paid 50 roubles in dividends per 1,000 rouble share.
In 1997 Mosenergo plans to raise funds for its investment programmes through borrowing, it said in a statement.

A forthcoming $150 million Eurobond issue and a European Bank for Reconstruction and Development credit now under consideration, will help Mosenergo fund reconstruction of old stations and build new ones, it said.
The total 1997 investment plan amounts to 2.56 trillion roubles, or about $450 million, it said.
